title: Study of a seated lady
material: pen and brown ink on laid paper
description: Study of a seated lady pen and brown ink on laid paper 8.7 x 7.5cm (3 7/16 x 2 15/16in). framed: 26.8 x 24cm
provenance: In the present owner's family for approximately 50 years |  | We are grateful to Alex Kidson for suggesting that this is an early study. The sitter appears to rest her hand on a head, and there are a few examples where this idea is translated into paint, with the head being a classical bust of some philosopher indicating the lady's intelligence.
